title: PWA support and mobile responsive dashboard
summary: Dashboard can now be installed as a standalone app and works properly on mobile devices.

sections.heading: New
items: Dashboard can be installed as a PWA with service worker and manifest for standalone use on Android

sections.heading: Improved
items: Dashboard is now mobile responsive with fixed overflow on events dialog, month strip, and layout padding
Login page now features a split-layout design with brand panel and geometric pattern

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Logo now displays correctly on login page by serving it without authentication
